comboData.title: One Magician's Rod: Full Backrow (2026)
comboData.description: A one-card line from a single Normal Summon of Magician's Rod, built on the Pharaoh's Servant wave. Rod searches Dark Magical Curtain, Curtain brings out Dark Magician and adds Soul Servant, and that Dark Magician becomes Dark Magician of Destruction, which searches Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant. The Servant Sets Magician's Salvation, Salvation Sets Eternal Soul, and Soul Servant draws you Magicians' Souls, which revives Dark Magician Girl so Salvation can bring the Servant back. You end with Dark Magician of Destruction, Miasma Necromancer, Dark Magician Girl and the Servant, with Salvation active and Eternal Soul Set.

comboData.title: Illusion of Chaos into Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon
comboData.description: A two-card line from Illusion of Chaos and Dark Magical Circle that leaves The Gaze of Timaeus Set for your opponent's turn. Illusion of Chaos finds Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant, which reveals Circle to Special Summon itself and Set Gaze from the Deck. Activating Circle lets you banish the Servant for Dark Magician of Destruction, which searches Eternal Soul. On your opponent's turn, Gaze shuffles Destruction back into the Extra Deck to Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon, which stays until the End Phase of your next turn.

Auroradon floods the field with Deskbot 001 copies and Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion to Synchro Summon Accel Synchron, then bridges further into Borreload Savage Dragon and Herald of the Arc Light. Toon Kingdom closes out the turn, banishing Toon Mermaid, Toon Dark Magician, and a hand monster to Special Summon Red-Eyes Toon Dragon. Heads-up: this line uses Crystron Halqifibrax, Linkross, Mecha Phantom Beast Auroradon, Borreload Savage Dragon and Herald of the Arc Light, which are Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.
